headline: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation: 89 measures now on the platform, naming 10 sectors
body: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation is now on the platform. Its 89 measures have been read one provision at a time. The act names 10 sectors in its own text — most often Retail and distribution, on 46 measures — and reaches 3 more through supply chains, dependencies on other acts, or procurement. This act is adopted. It is law, not a proposal.

headline: CBAM extension — downstream goods and anti-circumvention: 61 measures now on the platform, naming 6 sectors
body: CBAM extension — downstream goods and anti-circumvention is now on the platform. Its 61 measures have been read one provision at a time. The act names 6 sectors in its own text — most often Steel, on 41 measures. The proposal COM(2025) 989, under procedure 2025/0419(COD), would change an act already in force. What it adds is not law yet; the act it changes is.

headline: EU ETS revision: 51 measures now on the platform, naming 8 sectors
body: EU ETS revision is now on the platform. Its 51 measures have been read one provision at a time. The act names 8 sectors in its own text — most often Aviation, on 10 measures. This is a Commission proposal, COM(2026) 616, under procedure 2026/0212(COD). It is not law yet, and it can change before it is.

headline: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation replaces Packaging and Packaging Waste Directive: 12 measures change
body: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation replaces the Packaging and Packaging Waste Directive. 12 measures change, and the earlier wording is on file for 12 of them, shown against what each requires now. These measures name 8 sectors — most often Plastics converting, on 6 of them — and reach 3 more through supply chains, dependencies on other acts, or procurement. This act is adopted. It is law, not a proposal.
